sources.entry: Iconizer - Create Xcode image catalogs (xcassets) on the fly.

summary.one_liner: Iconizer is a macOS app that creates Xcode image catalogs (.xcassets) and generates the required images for App Icons, Launch Images and Image Sets.
summary.what_it_does: Iconizer builds the file structure of an Xcode asset catalog for you and generates all the images that App Icons, Launch Images and Image Sets require. The README describes it as a tool that creates xcassets on the fly. It is distributed as a downloadable release, as source code that must be compiled, and through Homebrew Cask. The README does not describe the interface or the input image requirements in detail. It points to a homepage for more information. It also links to a separate app, Icns Composer, for creating icns files for OS X.
use_cases: generate iOS app icon sets for Xcode
create launch image assets for an Xcode project
produce image set assets for Xcode
how_to_run: Download the latest release and drop it into your Applications folder.
Or download the source code and compile it yourself (requires Carthage to install Sparkle).
Or install via Homebrew Cask: brew install --cask iconizer
stack: Objective-C/Swift macOS app (inferred from build tooling; not stated)
notable: Generates the full xcassets folder structure and images in one step
Covers App Icons, Launch Images and Image Sets
Available as a direct download, source build, or Homebrew Cask
Source build depends on Carthage to fetch Sparkle
caveats: Source build requires Carthage and compiling the project yourself
README gives no details on input image requirements or supported Xcode versions
Distributed for macOS only, as the README refers to the Applications folder and Homebrew Cask
